references.text: Describes the wave breast and the heave thigh as the priests' portion of the peace offering, using the same terms as in Exodus 29:27
The fulfillment of the ordination offering where Moses takes the breast as a wave offering, directly parallel to the ram of ordination mentioned in the text
Repeats the instructions regarding the wave breast and the heave thigh belonging to Aaron and his sons
Mentions the wave breast and the heave thigh in connection with the Nazirite offering, using the same terminology concerning holy gifts for the priest
Confirms that the wave offerings and the heave offerings belong to Aaron and his sons as a perpetual right
The immediate context describing the ram of ordination and how the breast and the thigh are to be waved and lifted
A direct parallel confirming and elaborating on the rule that the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering belong to the priest.
